name: RC-B10-0514/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the post-election killings and deteriorating human rights situation in Tanzania, including the case of imprisoned opposition leader Tundu Lissu
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Tanzania after the October 2025 elections. It condemns the violence by security forces, the arrests of opposition members and the shutdown of the internet. It calls for the release of opposition leader Tundu Lissu, who is held on treason charges, and for an independent investigation into killings and disappearances. It also asks the European Union to stop direct support to the Tanzanian authorities and to consider sanctions.

- The European Union may stop direct support to Tanzania's authorities and consider sanctions on those responsible.
- This affects Tanzania's government, security forces, opposition members, journalists and civil society.
- Tanzania is asked to hold new, credible elections and to talk with the opposition; the Parliament's position is not binding.
